content:
We are heading into the weekend with the massive Labor Day sale at Amazon and the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, but Best Buy has now updated its sale event with new deals and we have some fresh offers to scope out elsewhere. We still have the 2026 Apple Studio Display XDR hitting the Amazon all-time low at $329 off, this standard Studio Display model at the all-time low, and some Apple Refurb options at up to $500 off. Just be sure to also scope out this Midnight 16GB/1TB 13-inch M5 MacBook Air is $150 off via Amazon and this new Dark Cherry smart display charging collection to match your new iPhone 18 Pro – there are some notable launch deals live. Check it all out below.

Amazon’s massive 2026 Labor Day sale now live! Thousands of deals: Apple, Android, TVs, tech under $100, more from under $5

Best Buy updates giant Labor Day sale with new deals: OLED TV $800 off, Apple, Galaxy phones, appliances extra $1,000 off, more

Amazon has the best deal on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off for Labor Day weekend

Best Buy has now updated its giant Labor Day sale, but Amazon has since injected its competitor event with fresh new deals, not the least of which has Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off the list price. We are still very much not expecting Apple to update its pro buds to the next-generation this month, and that leaves this Pro 3 deal as one of the best Labor Day offers of the year.

Amazon is currently offering AirPods Pro 3 down a $199 shipped. Regularly $249, this is a straight up $50 off one of, if not, the best and most popular set of ANC buds you can buy.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 Amazon Resale $79 (Reg. $129)

Apple’s Midnight 16GB/1TB 13-inch M5 MacBook Air is $150 off at Amazon today

Deals on brand new condition M5 MacBook Air models have popped up here and there, but they have been largely intermittent since the price increase a couple months back. Today, however, as part of its Labor Day sale, Amazon is offering this Midnight 13-inch model at $150 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 1TB storage capacity down at $1,449 shipped.

This is the Midnight model that regularly catches a $1,599 list price from Apple and other retailers. Today Amazon has dropped the price to deliver a solid $150 in savings and some notable price increase relief.

Apple’s 2026 Studio Displays hit Amazon all-time lows for Labor Day (Deals up to $500 off)

As part of its Labor Day sale, yesterday afternoon we spotted Amazon dropping this 2026 Apple Studio Display XDR to a new all-time low at $329 off, and today we are getting another chance at its best price yet on the more affordable Studio Display with the Nano-Texture Glass and Tilt-Adjustable Stand at $215 off. Head below for a closer look and some additional discount options at up to $500 off.

Amazon is now once again offering the latest 2026 model Apple Studio Display with the Tilt-Adjustable Stand and Nano-Texture Glass down at $1,684.88 shipped. You’ll have to clip the on-page coupon to redeem the sale price.

You’re looking at the standard 2026 Apple Studio Display here, but one with the Nano-Texture Glass upgrade and the included Tilt-Adjustable Stand that carries an $1,899 list price. Today’s deal is on par with the deal we spotted yesterday – the on-page coupon disappeared mid-day and has now returned for another shot at the Amazon all-time low here.

  • Apple Studio Display $1,503 (Reg. $1,599)
    • With Tilt-Adjustable Stand and Standard Glass
  • Apple Studio Display $1,685 (Reg. $1,899) – NEW all-time low
    • With Tilt-Adjustable Stand and Nano-Texture Glass
  • Apple Studio Display XDR $2,970 (Reg. $3,299) – NEW all-time low
    • With Tilt- and Height-Adjustable Stand and Standard Glass

Apple’s latest 2026 Studio Display certainly isn’t cheap, even with the deals, but it is gorgeous and if you are thinking of an upgrade there are a few models seeing notable discounts right now at Amazon. Just be sure to also explore the official Apple Refurb Store as well – there are some of the 2026 models at up to $500 off there right now.

Sony’s 2026 BRAVIA 7 II HDR TV is $800 off for Labor Day

The official Sony site is running an impressive Labor Day sale of its own headlined by some of its 2026 BRAVIA TVs. Joining deals on some its latest headphones, DSLR/mirrorless cameras, and more, we are also tracking up to $800 off its latest 2026 BRAVIA 7 II and BRAVIA 8 II smart TVs.

  • BRAVIA 7 II 65-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini $1,800 (Reg. $2,600)

More Sony Labor Day TV deals live right now:

  • BRAVIA 7 II 50-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini $1,400 (Reg. $1,600)
  • BRAVIA 7 II 55-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini $1,500 (Reg. $2,100)
  • BRAVIA 7 II 75-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini $2,300 (Reg. $3,100)

Apple deals starting to disappear, grab AirTag 2 at the best price ever ($20 each)

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (Reg. $99) – NEW all-time low

Apple’s MagSafe Battery now back at $59 all-time low, or $39 via Amazon Resale

Baseus debuts Dark Cherry smart display charging collection to match your new iPhone 18 Pro [Launch deals]

Baseus just unleashed a new 100W PicoGo Pro Smart Display charger as part of its IFA 2026 announcements, and you can now snag one with a nice launch deal at $39.99 shipped via the brand’s official Amazon storefront. Be sure to enter promo code BSAH2295T during checkout to see the discounted price. This brand-new charger just hit the scene carrying a $60 price tag, but the promo code takes $20 off that price to mark a new best price to beat. You can get this in Dark Cherry and Black finishes, and they’re both down to the $40 low today as part of this launch deal. Head below for more details.

UGREEN just unleashed three new Qi2.2 25W MagFlow chargers at IFA for travel, desk setups, and more [Launch deals]

M6 Mac mini pre-order discounts live at Amazon ahead of delivery this month

Alongside the Labor Day sales now live at Best Buy and Amazon, we are moving closer to delivery day on the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro model. If you’re still considering a pre-order, scoop up the new $9 Apple Polishing Cloth before it sells out and check out the discounts Amazon is offering on Apple’s new Mac mini pre-orders.

We have already highlighted these deals in various posts as they went live, but we wanted to make sure they were all in one place and on the radar for folks still considering a pre-order ahead of this month’s delivery date:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (Reg. $1,699)

  • Amazon Anker Labor Day sale now live at up to 42% off! Deals on chargers, power banks, Qi2.2 gear, more from just $12
  • Land a set of current-gen Beats Solo Buds for just $35 today
  • UGREEN’s 160W smart display charger with retractable cable returns to its lowest price for Labor Day at $100
  • Take a vertical mouse for a spin while Acer’s textured model is only $18

  • ECOVACS debuts DEEBOT X12S OmniCyclone robot vacuum and mop at IFA 2026 with $300 launch savings
  • Twelve South AirFly Pro Wireless Audio Transmitter for your AirPods now down at $40
  • Drop TESSAN’s slim 4-in-1 travel adapter in your bag while it’s down to $16
  • Just $11.50 adds this stainless steel Apple Watch band to your collection (54% off)
  • Spigen launches sporty new Apple Magnetic Link-style band from $22

Official Apple accessories from $5.50 today: USB-C cables, Apple Watch bands, more

Alongside the Amazon Labor Day sale, today Woot has launched a wide-ranging Apple sale with an extra 10% off at checkout. Loaded with iPad and MacBook models, it also features a series of notable discounts on official Apple accessories – USB-C cables, MagSafe 3 cables, Apple Watch bands, and more. On top of the already discounted rates, you can also use code APPLETEN at checkout for an extra 10% off items in this sale – just note there’s a limit of one coupon use per customer.

While you will find a host of refurbished gear here, including iPads and MacBooks, as well as some deep deals on previous-generation gear, there are also a host of notable discounts on accessories – this is typically where the best values are in these sales for folks not interested in the refurbs.

iPhone 17 Pro models drop to new Amazon all-time lows again at up to $285 off (Renewed Premium)

Alongside the Labor Day sale at Best Buy with deals on iPhone Air, and Amazon’s massive sale event, we are catching some solid discounts on iPhone 17 Pro as well. While not all color and configs are down quite as low as they were last week, we are now tracking new Amazon all-time low pricing on its best quality Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro models at up to $285 off. Apple will unleash the new iPhone 18 Pro models very soon, but you can bet they are going to be a whole lot more expensive than this.

As I have said previously, Amazon Renewed Premium units are the best way to land a deal on current-generation iPhone units, and especially iPhone 17 Pro right now. Apple does not sell them in the official refurb store, and even once it does, the prices are rarely ever as low as Amazon:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,214 (Reg. $1,499 new) – New all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,214 (Reg. $1,499 new) – all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,149 (Reg. $1,299 new) – New all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,165 (Reg. $1,299 new) – New all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,171 (Reg. $1,299 new)

All of these units come with a full 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life.” Just make sure you use the links above and watch out for third-party sellers otherwise.
